title: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Anime's New Video Reveals More Cast, Ending Song, January 3 Debut
content:
Kadokawa revealed a new promotional video, additional cast members, and January 3 premiere for the television anime of Toru Shirogame's The Kept Man of the Princess Knight ( Himekishi-sama no Himo ) light novel series on Wednesday. The video previews the ending theme song "Gika" (Pseudanthium) by the rock band sajou no hana .

The newly announced cast members are:

Yūya Hirose as Ralph, a young warrior of the adventurer party Aegis led by Arwin

Manaka Iwami as Noel, a newcomer in the Aegis party

Shion Wakayama as Beatrice, the mage and leader of the adventurer party Medusa and the younger of the Mallet sisters

Saori Ōnishi as Cecilia, mage of the Medusa party and Beatrice's older sister

The Dungeon City is a wicked place filled with crime, debauchery, and death. Its one shining light is Arwin, the beautiful Crimson Princess Knight. She and her brave party of adventurers descend into the dungeon at the city's center, seeking a legendary treasure with the power to rebuild the princess's fallen kingdom. Many yearn to be by her side, but that spot is already taken by Matthew, a man despised by all in town as a cowardly weakling. Everyone thinks he is scum who just spends her hard-earned money on booze, women, and gambling. No one in the city—not even the princess knight— knows what Matthew is truly capable of.

The anime stars:

• Junichi Suwabe as Matthew

• Mikako Komatsu as Arwin

• Rie Takahashi as Vanessa

• Tetsu Inada as Dezu

• Rika Nagae as April

Chihiro Kumano ( Eiga Odekake Kozame Tokai no Otomodachi , A Couple of Cuckoos ) is directing the series at BLADE . Hisao Ishii ( There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless... , In Search of the Lost Future ) is designing the characters based on the original light novel designs by Saki Mashima . Deko Akao ( After the Rain , Arakawa Under the Bridge ) is in charge of series scripts.

Other staff members include:

• Action Director: Hibiki Yamaguchi

• Prop Design/Monster Design: Recommendation, Inc.

• Art Setting: Shingo Kakimoto (Quun Plant)

• Art Director: Ryōsuke Kawai (Quun Plant)

• Color Design: Naomi Nakano (Stella)

• Assistant Color Design: Yuki Kadomatsu (Stella)

• 3D Director: Yoshinori Ban

• 2D Works: Yumeta Company

• Compositing Director of Photography: Kōdai Washizu

• Offline Editing: Nobutaka Maki (TAVAC), Kiminori Yoshida (TAVAC)

• Music: Taku Iwasaki

• Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama

• Casting Manager: Ippei Tomari

• Sound Producer: INSPION Edge

The anime will premiere on the AT-X channel on January 3 at 11:30 p.m. JST (9:30 a.m. EST). The anime will then run on Tokyo MX at 24:30 JST, and on BS Asahi at 25:30 JST (effectively January 4 at 12:30 a.m. and 1:30 a.m., respectively).

Shirogane's light novel series reached over 200,000 copies in circulation and won the 28th annual Dengeki Novel Awards grand prize. Kadokawa will ship the eighth novel volume on January 8. Yen Press shipped the sixth volume on August 11.

Keyyang launched a manga adaptation of the light novel series. Kadokawa shipped the third and final compiled book volume in December 2024. Yen Press publishes the manga in English and shipped the third compiled book volume on January 6.

Chihiro Yamazaki launched a new manga series based on the novels titled Himekishi-sama no Himo Act 2 ( The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Act 2) on Kadokawa 's KadoComi website in August 2025. Kadokawa published the manga's first volume on January 27, and will publish the second volume on December 24.

title: Supporting Cast for 'Cheat Fuyo' Announced
content:
The official X account of the Tsuihou sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka suru. Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu? ( The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a New Life: I Can Add "Enhancement Points" Not Just to Weapons but to Anything, and I Can Cancel the Effects Whenever I Want, but Are the People Left Behind Going to Be Okay? ) television anime announced additional cast members Wednesday. The anime series adapting Asa Rokushima and Youmochi Gyoumu 's adventure fantasy manga began airing on October 7 at 12:00 a.m. on TV Tokyo, followed by AT-X.

Cast Mirasuke: Natsumi Kawaida ( Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga ) Mirakichi: Ruriko Noguchi ( Itai no wa Iya nanode Bougyoryoku ni Kyokufuri Shitai to Omoimasu. ) Miratarou: Nene Hieda ( Summer Pockets ) Mirazou: Misato Matsuoka ( Yani Neko ) Mirajirou: Sayaka Kikuchi ( Fantasy Bishoujo Juniku Ojisan to ) Miranori: Hana Hishikawa ( Sayonara Lara )

Shuu Honma ( Mayonaka Punch ) is directing the anime at P.A. Works , with Youko Yonaiyama ( Yubisaki to Renren ) handling the series composition. Yuito Kiyosawa ( Mikadono Sanshimai wa Angai, Choroi. sub-character design) is designing the characters. Alisa Okehazama ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) is composing the music.

Rokushima began penning the adventure fantasy story on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in January 2021. Youmochi Gyoumu began serializing the manga in Shounen Magazine R in October that year and transferred it to Getsumaga Kichi web manga portal in March 2023 following the former's discontinuation. Kodansha published the 22th volume on October 8.

Kodansha began publishing the light novel adaptation under its K Ranobe Book label with illustrations by kisui in January 2022. The second volume went on sale in October 2022.

Kodansha began simulpublishing the manga in English on its K Manga service as The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life on March 19.

title: 'Historie' Unveils Production Staff, Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Hitoshi Iwaaki 's Historie manga revealed the production staff, additional cast, theme songs, key visual (pictured), and a second promotional video on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere as a two-episode special on January 9 at 1:23 a.m. on MBS, TBS, CBC, and Prime Video, followed by BS-TBS and AT-X.

Cast Antigonus: Fumihiko Tachiki ( Bleach ) Satura: Akira Sekine ( Tenmaku no Jaadugar ) Bato: Toshiki Masuda ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Dimakos: Ryouta Takeuchi ( Mahoutsukai no Yome ) Telemakos: Seiichirou Yamashita ( 86 ) Narrator: Mirai Moriyama ( Saint☆Oniisan )

Staff Director: Nobuharu Kamanaka ( Toaru Kagaku no Accelerator ) Assistant Director: Takaaki Suzuki ( Toujima Tanzaburou wa Kamen Rider ni Naritai ) Character Design, Chief Animation Director: Isoroku Koga ( Mattaku Saikin no Tantei to Kitara ) Series Composition, Script: Toshiya Oono ( 86 ) Prop Design: Kenichi Ootomo ( Bungou Stray Dogs key animation) Art Director: Minami Kasuga ( Beastars ) Art Design: Eiko Tsunadou ( Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu ) Color Design: Aiko Yamagami ( Isekai de Cheat Skill wo Te ni Shita Ore wa, Genjitsu Sekai wo mo Musou Suru ) 2D Design: Misato Kuramochi (Asahi Production) ( Kingdom 5th Season ) Director of Photography: Naho Hasegawa (Asahi Production) ( Zom 100 ) 3DCG: SANZIGEN Editing: Mai Hasegawa (Editz) ( Mizu Zokusei no Mahoutsukai ) Music: Gin Hashiba ( Tensei Kenja no Isekai Life ) Sound Director: Noriyoshi Konuma ( Tenmaku no Jaadugar ) Sound Production: Bit grooove promotion Historical Research: Shishin Fujimura Studio: LIDENFILMS

• Yorushika ( Sousou no Frieren ) is performing the opening theme "Masshiro" and Retroriron ( Higeki no Genkyou to Naru Saikyou Gedou Last Boss Joou wa Tami no Tame ni Tsukushimasu. Season 2 ) performs the ending theme "Amphilia." The opening theme is previewed in the promotional video below.

Iwaaki began serializing the historical adventure manga in Afternoon magazine in January 2003. Kodansha published the 12th volume in June 2024.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English for an omnibus physical release in July 2026, with the first two volumes planned to be released on April 27, 2027. The manga is published digitally by Kodansha through the K Manga website.

PV 2

title: Historie Anime's Video Unveils More Cast & Staff, Theme Songs, January 8 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of Hitoshi Iwaaki 's Historié manga presented a new promotional video and visual for the anime on Wednesday. The video announced more cast and staff members, the theme songs, and January 8 television and streaming premiere date for the anime

yorushika performs the anime's opening theme song "Masshiro" (Pure White), which is also previewed in the above video. RETRORIRON is performing the anime's ending theme song "Amphoria."

The anime will debut MBS , TBS , CBC , and BS-TBS on January 8, and will also debut streaming on Amazon Prime Video on January 8. The anime will debut on AT-X on January 10.

The new cast members include:

Fumihiko Tachiki as Antigonus, a mysterious one-eyed merchant from Perinthus

Akira Sekine as Satura, a villager of Boa, and daughter of Boa's past village headman

Toshiki Masuda as Bato, a villager of Boa who has skill with a sword

Ryōta Takeuchi as Dimakos, the eldest son of Philetaerus, archon of the city-state of Tios

Seiichirō Yamashita as Telemakos, Philetaerus' second son, and Dimakos' younger brother

Mirai Moriyama is also narrating the anime.

Nobuharu Kamanaka ( Detective Conan episodes 975-present, Roll Over and Die , Big Order ) is directing the anime at LIDEN FILMS , with Takatoshi Suzuki as the assistant director. Toshiya Ono ( Land of the Lustrous , SHOSHIMIN: How to become Ordinary , 86 ) is writing and supervising the series' scripts. Isoroku Koga ( Detectives These Days Are Crazy! ) is the character designer and chief animation director. Gin Hashiba is composing the music. Scholar and historical consultant Sisin Fujimura is credited for historical research.

Other staff members include Ken'ichi Ōtomo as prop designer, Minami Kasuga as the art director, Eiko Tsunadō for art setting, Misato Kuramochi ( Asahi Production ) for 2D design, Naho Hasegawa as the compositing director of photography, SANZIGEN for the 3D CG, Mai Hasegawa ( EditZ ) for editing, Noriyoshi Konuma as the sound director.

Previously announced cast members include:

• Nobunaga Shimazaki as protagonist Eumenes

• Ryōta Suzuki as Hieronymous, Eumenes' older brother

• Kazuya Ichijō as Hieronymous (the Elder), Eumenes' father

• Yūko Kaida as Telesilla, Eumenes' mother

• Wataru Takagi as Charon, a slave serving the Hieronymous family

• Satoshi Tsuruoka as Hecateus, a close aide to Hieronymous

• Anri Katsu as Thrax, a slave of the Scythians

• Tsuguo Mogami as Aristotle, an iconic philosopher of Ancient Greece

• Miki Kariya as Perialla, Eumenes' close friend since childhood

• Seiyū Fujiwara as Nicogenes, Eumenes' friend who attends the same school as him

• Junya Enoki as Tolmides, Eumenes' friend

Kodansha 's K MANGA is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

After shocking the world with Parasyte , Hitoshi Iwaaki is back with a series he's been aching to tackle since even before his pro manga debut! A historical epic set in ancient times, Historié tells the story of Eumenes, a young man with quick wits and a vast destiny to fulfill. In time, he'll become a famed army commander and personal secretary to Alexander the Great—but the road to this glory is fraught with danger

Iwaaki began his ongoing manga Historié in Kodansha 's Afternoon magazine in October 2004. Kodansha published the manga's 12th compiled book volume on June 21, 2024, and the series has over 4.7 million copies in circulation. The series won the Japanese government's Ministry of Cultural Affairs' Media Arts Festival Award for manga in 2010 and the 16th Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2012. It won the Best General Manga category in the 49th Kodansha Manga Awards in 2025.

Iwaaki noted in the announcement of the anime that he first conceived the story over four decades ago, and first began sketching the art in his then-tiny studio some 20-odd years ago.

Iwaaki's Parasyte ( Kiseiju ) manga ran from 1990 to 1995 and inspired an anime series and two live-action films from 2014 to 2015.

title: 'Haru to Gen ~70-sai, Hajimete Kosodate~' Anime's Teaser Reveals More Cast, Ending Song
content:
The staff for the short-format television anime of Yuka Ōshima 's Haru to Gen ~70-sai, Hajimete Kosodate~ (Haru and Gen: Raising a Child for the First Time at 70) manga presented a new teaser promotional video and additional cast members on Wednesday. The video reveals and previews the ending theme song "Chokin-bako Mitai na♡Song" (A Piggy Bank-Like♡Song) by Nono-chan ( Nonoka Murakata ). Kuricorder Quartet performed the music for the ending theme song, Reo Rinozuka wrote the lyrics, and Masaki Kurihara composed the music. Makoto Kimura of BLUE RIGHTS and Naho Fujisawa of Nippon Columbia are the music producers.

The newly announced cast members are:

• Jin Urayama as Ginji

• Hitomi Shogawa as Kaoru

• Nao Shiraki as Ai

• Akiko Seri as Ūpii

The manga's story centers on Gen, a 70-year-old man who was estranged by his wife and daughter after a divorce many years ago. After his daughter's death, he has been entrusted to take care of his three-year-old granddaughter Haru. Having neglected his family in the past, Gen now faces the challenge of raising a child for the first time, along with its unexpected twists and turns.

The cast includes:

• Bin Shimada as Gen, a divorced 70 year old man living alone

• Hiromi Igarashi as Haru, Gen's granddaughter

• Mayuko Kazama as Sakura, Gen's only daughter, who died from an illness

Kōdai Satō ( Tom to Jerry Gokko ) is directing the anime at IMAGICA Infos and Imageworks Studio in collaboration with Studio Nanahoshi . Taeko Miura ( Kanagawa Elves , Hyakki Yakou Shou ) is directing the sound, Maki Takuma ( After-School Hanako-kun , Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club ) is in charge of sound effects, and bermei.inazawa ( Potion, Waga Mi o Tasukeru , Marukano ) is composing the music. RD is in charge of sound production, and Kazuya Takahashi ( Love and Lies , Saiyuki Reload Blast ) is the executive producer.

The anime will premiere on the TV Kanagawa (tvk) channel on January 4 at 9:55 p.m. (7:55 a.m. EST).

Ōshima launched the manga on Kadokawa 's TATESC Comic vertical-scrolling, full-color webcomic label in December 2022. Kadokawa published the manga's first compiled book volume in March 2024.

Taeko Miura ( Kanagawa Elves , Hyakki Yakou Shou ) is directing the sound, Maki Takuma ( After-School Hanako-kun , Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club ) is in charge of sound effects, and bermei.inazawa ( Potion, Waga Mi o Tasukeru , Marukano ) is composing the music. RD is in charge of sound production, and Kazuya Takahashi ( Love and Lies , Saiyuki Reload Blast ) is the executive producer.
The anime will premiere on the TV Kanagawa (tvk) channel on January 4 at 9:55 p.m. (7:55 a.m. EST).
Ōshima launched the manga on Kadokawa 's TATESC Comic vertical-scrolling, full-color webcomic label in December 2022. Kadokawa published the manga's first compiled book volume in March 2024.

title: Live-Action 10 Things I Want to Do Before I Turn 40 Film's Trailer Reveals Theme Song
content:
The official website for the live-action film sequel of the live-action series of Mamita 's 10 Things I Want to Do Before I Turn 40 ( 40 Made ni Shitai 10 no Koto ) boys-love manga began streaming a new trailer for the film on Wednesday. The trailer announces and previews the film's theme song "Taisetsu" (Special) by rock band sumika .

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga, and released the second volume on September 1. The company describes the story:

Suzume Tōjō is just three months away from turning forty and realizes there's so much he hasn't done with his life! So, he makes a plan: create a private list of things he's always wanted to do and check them off before turning the big four-oh. It's a rather simple list, filled with goals that should be easy to accomplish, like a takoyaki party, enjoying a parfait out in a cafe, and spending his birthday with a lover. Except, that last one comes with a major problem--Tōjō hasn't had a lover in ten years! But when Keishi Tanaka, Tōjō's handsome junior at the company, discovers the secret list, he's determined to help Tōjō check off every single item--starting with the "lover" part!

The cast members of the TV series are reprising their roles for the film. Kōhei Shōji plays Keishi Tanaka, while Shunsuke Kazama plays Suzume Tōjō.

Chihiro Ikeda returns to direct the film based on a screenplay by Yō Saitō.

The film will open on January 22.

Ikeda (live-action Senpai to Kanojo , Kowloon Generic Romance ) and Noriaki Kosuge (co-director of Yo-kai Watch: Sora Tobu Kujira to Double Sekai no Daibōken da Nyan! live-action segment) directed the series, with scripts by Saitō (Aibō) . Erina Koyama (live-action Kowloon Generic Romance ) composed the music.

The live-action series premiered on the TV Tokyo , TV Osaka , TV Aichi , TV Setouchi , TV Hokkaido , and TVQ channels in July 2025 and also streamed on Lemino , U-NEXT , TV Tokyo HP, and TVer services in Japan.

Mamita launched the manga in Libre Publishing 's Be x Boy magazine in 2022. Libre Publishing released the manga's second and final volume in February 2025. The author released an extra third volume for the manga on June 10.

Seven Seas is also releasing Mamita 's Wanna Be My Dress-Up Lover? and Natsume Wants to be Trained manga. SuBLime previously released Mamita 's The Metalhead Next Door manga.

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End Manga Gets Spinoff Manga Mini-Series
content:
The staff for Kanehito Yamada and Tsukasa Abe 's Frieren: Beyond Journey's End ( Sōsō no Frieren ) manga announced on Wednesday that the manga will receive a short manga mini-series titled Sōsō no Frieren : Betsutan ( Frieren: Beyond Journey's End : Another Story) in Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine beginning on December 2. Yamada is supervising the title, Abe is drawing the manga, and Mei Hachimoku is credited with the story alongside Yamada.

The mini-series' story is set between the first and second chapters of the main manga, and focuses on Frieren and Heiter from a different point-of-view from the main manga.

Hachimoku is the author of the Frieren: Beyond Journey's End ~Prelude~ light novel, which shipped in April 2024. The prequel novel is a collection of five short stories that are not included in the manga's story featuring Frieren, Fern, Stark, Lawine and Kanne, and Aura. The novel depicts Frieren before she goes on a journey to "get to know people." Yen Press published the novel in English in March.

The main manga series is currently on an indefinite hiatus that started in October 2025, for creators Yamada and Abe to take stock of their health, and consider adjusting the serialization pace of the series.

Yamada and Abe launched the ongoing manga in Shogakukan 's Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine in April 2020. The series had returned from a hiatus in July 2025. The manga's 15th compiled book volume shipped on December 18.

The manga has exceeded 30 million copies in circulation worldwide.

The television anime 's third season will air in October 2027.

title: Live-Action 2027 Kaiji Film Unveils Full Trailer, Poster, More Cast
content:
TOHO Movies revealed the full trailer, poster, and more cast members for Kaiji: Jinsei Revenge Game (Kaiji: Life Revenge Game), the new live-action film of Nobuyuki Fukumoto 's Kaiji manga on Wednesday.

The trailer shows the title Gambler Kaiji going head-to-head with Kazuya Hyōdō, the second head of the Teiai Corporation. It also highlights the deadly games that Kaiji takes on this time, including a VR version of the franchise 's iconic steel-beam crossing, and the appearance of a character thought to be dead.

The newly announced cast members include (top row, left to right):

• Katsuhisa Namase as Kōtarō Sakazaki

• Ken Mitsuishi as Kōji Ishida

• Yusuke Onuki as Kyōsuke Kaiji

(second row, left to to right):

• Toru Baba as Kurofuku

• Shinya Niiro as Event MC

• Reika Sakurai as Teiai CM character

Tatsuya Fujiwara reprises his role as the titular character Kaiji.

Previously announced cast members include Kazuya Kamenashi ( The Drops of God , live-action Kindaichi Case Files ) as Kazuya Hyōdō, Mahiro Takasugi ( I Want to Eat Your Pancreas , live-action Tokyo Revengers 2 ) as Teiai Corporation employee Keita Mashimo, Sara Minami ( Grotesqqque , live-action Kimi ni Todoke ) as Keita's girlfriend Taeko Yūki. and Susumu Terajima ( When Marnie Was There , live-action Lovely Complex ) as golf course employee Kōzō Nonomura.

Tōya Satō is also returning to direct the new film. Yūgo Kanno is composing the music for the film. Masatoshi Yamaguchi penned the script with assistance from Fukumoto.

The film will open in theaters on January 29.

Denpa licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Ne'er-do-well Kaiji Itō's shiftless existence is suddenly rattled by a visit from the yakuza. Burdened by debt and resentment, Kaiji is coerced into gambling for his worthless life. As the stakes grow higher and the rules become increasingly more bizarre, Kaiji must finally take the future into his own hands! Legendary mangaka Nobuyuki Fukumoto finally makes his English-language debut. The inspiration for the infamous anime by the same name and the Netflix live-action film Animal World takes readers into the dark side of Japan's post-bubble economic society by thrusting them into a world of debt, debauchery, and delusion.

Fukumoto serialized the original manga in Kodansha 's Young Magazine from 1996 to 1999. The manga has inspired multiple sequels and spinoffs, two television anime series , three previous Japanese live-action films, a Chinese live-action film , and a reality game show . Denpa shipped the third volume in December 2021.

Fukumoto announced in 2024 the Kaiji manga will end in the next arc.

The series is currently on hiatus. The manga first went on hiatus in June 2023 due to Fukumoto conducting research, and was slated to return in September of that year, but instead announced another hiatus in October, and was slated to return in November 2023, but the series has not resumed serialization since then. The manga last appeared in Kodansha 's Weekly Young Magazine 's 2023 27th issue in June.

title: Mitei Hattori's Smile! Manga Gets Live-Action Series With Global Release Plans
content:
Mitei Hattori announced on Wednesday, November 25 that his Smile! ( Smiley ) manga will receive a live-action series adaptation. (November 25 is nicknamed "Good Sm ile Say" in Japan, since 11-25 can be read as a Japanese wordplay on "ii niko" or "good sm ile.") The artist drew an illustration celebrating the announcement:

Akira Nagai ( Suzuki=Bakudan, Teiichi no Kuni , Koi wa Ameagari no You ni ) and Ryōhei Kumamoto are directing the series. TOHO is planning and presenting the project with "global" release plans, and TOHO Studios and AOI Pro. are producing. Kazuhisa Kotera ( Piple: AI and Married Life Has Begun , Mushikago no Jōmae ), Anna Kawahara ( Darwin Incident , Goodbye, Lara ), and Kento Mineo ( Bad Boys ) are co-writing the scripts.

Kyodo Printing Co., Ltd. 's Kodama Tales Inc. subsidiary releases the main Smile! manga in English, and it describes the psychological suspense story:

Yuushi Kamome is a freelance journalist who lost his beloved daughter in an unforeseen accident. His descent into despair following her death drove his wife to leave him, and he lives each day a shell of the man he once was. But his fate changes one day when members from a religious organization he had never heard of, the Smiling Hearts Society, knock on his door and hand him a flyer. He's ready to dismiss them until he notices the face of his estranged wife on the flyer, smiling ever so softly. And so begins a tale of religion and insanity. What kind of sinister darkness lurks behind this religion and its strange smiles?

Hattori launched the series in Nihonbungeisha 's Weekly Manga Goraku magazine in 2021. The series ended in March 2025, and Nihonbungeisha shipped the 11th and final compiled book volume on March 28, 2025. Kodama Tales released the fifth volume on September 1.

The 3,016th issue of Nihonbungeisha 's Weekly Manga Goraku magazine announced on Friday the series will receive an epilogue chapter manga in the magazine's next issue on December 4.

title: Demon Slayer Peaked Early, But Infinity Castle Can Save It
content:
The Demon Slayer anime peaked early thanks to its first season and movie, but the series still has the potential to surpass that success. The reason for its early success wasn’t its epic storytelling but rather Ufotable’s fascinating anime adaptation. The studio captivated anime fans worldwide with its vibrant animation, showcasing modern animation at its peak. However, what followed after the first season was the anime movie adaptation of the next canon arc from the manga, which is where the series truly peaked. It showcased a level of animation that surpassed everything else up until then.

First released in Japanese theaters in late 2020, the anime movie became a huge success. With the manga also approaching its conclusion at the time, the movie boosted manga sales exponentially, helping the series reach 150 million copies in total sales. Since then, the series has gained another 70 million copies in sales, surpassing 220 million as of this writing . However, despite two more seasons and another movie, the series has yet to match the heights it reached early on. The Infinity Castle trilogy, however, can surpass that achievement by building on what the franchise has already accomplished, and it is already doing so.

Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Can Take the Franchise to Even Greater Heights

Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle was a huge success for the franchise and at the box office, earning more than $200 million compared to Mugen Train . On paper, this already suggests that it is a bigger success than its predecessor. However, the main element Infinity Castle had going for it was its animation, which, despite being an improvement, was something fans had already come to expect. Many fans even believed that the movie should have been an anime season instead, as it essentially felt like nine episodes consolidated into a single film. That said, while its emotional impact may have fallen short compared to Rengoku’s death, the first movie has laid the foundation for what is to come next.

This is exactly what makes the next two movies’ potential to surpass it and reach even greater heights so exciting. The second movie will likely include two major events, potentially featuring the battles against Upper Moon Ranks One and Two. Once again, this could make the second movie feel like an entire season compiled into a single film. If that happens, the final installment, featuring the all-out battle against Muzan, could be the one that truly feels like a movie. As the final installment in the Demon Slayer franchise, it has the potential to elevate the series to even greater heights, surpassing what it has already achieved.

In other ways, the Demon Slayer franchise has already excelled, from its animation to its compelling and emotional storytelling. To surpass that foundation, bringing the climax to the big screen is what could truly solidify the franchise’s legacy as a visual masterpiece. The Demon Slayer franchise is already on a different level , having reached heights that fans might not have expected it to surpass. However, if the franchise aims to go even further and save itself as an anime that will be remembered for more than just its animation, it will need to stick the landing with its final film, something the concluding installment of the anime has the potential to achieve.
